message: I want to build the scheduling core for a tutoring app: tutors publish weekly availability and students book lessons. Start with a plain JavaScript library (no UI, no server, no database, no npm depen
result:
`booking.js` is built and tested. It exports `createScheduler(options)` with all eight methods, rules, defaults and error codes from your spec, and has no dependencies. All 73 tests pass with `node --test` (Node 22), including when the machine's time zone is set to America/New_York or Asia/Kolkata.

**Process:** I ran the project's planning workflow on its quick track. Your request already answered every question and asked me to build, so I treated it as approval of the plan and logged that in `.product-planner/decisions.md`. The plan has four tasks, all done and committed locally in two commits. Nothing was pushed.

**How it was tested:**
- **Every rule and error code has tests**, including the exact boundaries: exactly 12h notice is accepted, 56 days plus 30 minutes is rejected, a student can cancel at exactly 24h before but not one second later, and gaps exactly equal to `bufferMinutes` are allowed.
- **`listSlots` and `book` never disagree.** Both use the same check, and two tests confirm it: every listed slot books, and every bookable time is listed.
- **A failed reschedule leaves the booking unchanged.** This is checked after each of the seven ways a reschedule can fail.
- **The tests catch real bugs.** I broke the rules on purpose in 16 different ways and the suite failed every time.
- **An independent review** checked the code against your spec and found no rule violations. It found one real bug, now fixed and tested: some date strings, such as `'2026-10-21 10:00'`, were read in the server's local time instead of UTC. Input must now be strict ISO; anything else is rejected with `INVALID_START`.

**Choices I made where your spec was silent** (all recorded in `.product-planner/decisions.md`):
- **Returned times use the full ISO form**, e.g. `2026-10-20T10:00:00.000Z`, not the string you passed in. Times with no zone are read as UTC.
- **Adjacent availability blocks aren't merged.** With 09:00–10:00 and 10:00–11:00, a 09:30–10:30 lesson is rejected, because it isn't inside one block.
- **Extra error codes** cover bad input your list didn't: `INVALID_AVAILABILITY`, `INVALID_ACTOR`, `INVALID_TUTOR`, `DUPLICATE_TUTOR`, `INVALID_DATE`, `INVALID_OPTIONS`.
- **Leaving out `by` on cancel or reschedule counts as a student**, so a missing value never gets tutor rights.
- **A student can reschedule to a time inside the 24h window.** The window only applies to the lesson's current time, so they then can't cancel the moved lesson.
- **`studentId` isn't validated**, and students can book overlapping lessons with different tutors. Only tutor overlap is blocked, as specified.

One leftover file, `.product-planner/features-input.json`, is untracked and unused; deleting it needed a permission I didn't have, so you can delete it. The dashboard is at `product-dashboard.html`, and the rule-by-rule audit is in `.product-planner/acceptance.md`.
